name: Brent Frew
headline: Director, Corporate Partnerships
about: A project management & marketing professional who's focus is on delivering exceptional marketing campaign results, sales generation, engaged leadership, stakeholder/partner relations and process development.

experiences.description:
Key Responsibilities
• Negotiating long-term contracts and strategic partnerships with some of the world’s largest brands.
• Generating new revenue in our key partnership categories.
• Developing programs and marketing initiatives that align brand messaging and consumer engagement.
• Creating campaigns for clients that leverage all advertising platforms
• Generating revenue and partnerships for non-NHL events such as music and live events.
• Growing our Corporate Partnership business beyond our yearly revenue targets.

Directly responsible for overseeing a large team of Project Management and Marketing Professionals. Through working with many stakeholders and fostering long-term Partner relations, primary responsibilities are to deliver on brand objectives for over 80+ Partners, while supporting the revenue generating function. This is achieved through:

-Project Management and Strategic Process Oversight
-Contract Lifestyle Management
-Budget Maintenance & Controls
-Marketing & Sales Collateral Development
-Inventory Controls 
-Performance Reporting
-Media Scheduling & Reporting
-Market Research 
… more

As Manager, Corporate Partnership Services, responsibilities include:

-Through overseeing a team of partnership service staff, responsible for industry leading client relationships and contract execution 
-Responsible for timely execution of small and large scale projects while ensuring a high standard of excellence
-Work closely with the Marketing and Sales teams to optimize revenue through the creation and delivery of partnership solutions
-Participate in the development of annual Corporate Sales business plans
-Oversees the implementation and servicing of sponsor contracts
-Manages the CRM process for corporate sales
-Manages customer communications platforms for corporate sales
-Assists in managing the platforms and content of sales presentation material
-Collaborates in the preparation and distribution of partner summary and fulfillment reports
-Manages client hospitality and relationship building opportunities
-Develops and manages department budgets
-Recruits, trains, supervises and evaluates partnership service staff
… more

As Partnership Sales Specialists, responsibilities include:

-Liaison for national and local sponsorship accounts
-Design, develop and present corporate sponsorship proposals/presentations
-Campaign management and execution with consideration to multiple stakeholder interests
-Conceptualization and execution of partner advertising and communications programs
-Collaboration on design of graphics and communications materials for a variety of audiences
-Planning and management of premium stakeholder events
-Develop and maintain advertising inventory controls
-Prepare campaign recaps which include methodology, results, and analysis
-Work closely with clients to identify and align brand guidelines and strategies to provide targeted campaigns within Oilers mediums (television, print, radio, arena, digital, social media, event)
-Manage media ratings, research data, and survey information to monitor advertising effectiveness
